title: working on a dodgeball game for my arcade
author: rectangle_so
selftext:
I was sitting taking a break, sitting there rewatching and old show Recess & the episode I was on was called Dodgeball City then it kinda hit me.

What if I made my egg characters from my arcade play dodgeball LOL

So I got up and went back to work (so much for a break).   
  
Opened Cursor, and started chatting. I usually use ChatGPT, but since I'm out of usage (also out on Claude 🥹) I moved to Cursor using Grok 4.7 High Fast & Extra High Fast  
  
First thing I usually do when working on a new game is ask for visuals. I describe what I want and then it gives me a rough sketch. No the game yet. Then we go back and forth for a while on the design and the gameplay.

Then I start making the assets. Sometimes I ask for all of them, but I find I get better results when I ask for them one by one. Then I pulled the eggs sprites I already had, same ones I made like 5/6ish years ago for my first business and then I designed the court around them. 

That’s Dodge Yolk. Classic game of Dodgeball also probably the best game from gym class as a kid.   
  
Red versus blue. 

I’m still working on it. Polishing the small stuff, like how you sit on the bench after you die.   
  
For whatever reason Cursor keeps changing the size of the bench.

comments.author: rectangle_so
comments.body: how do you ideate new concepts?
